Entrant: Igor Eduardo, Cortexa Social · Date: 2026-10-18 · Proprietary data: none · External training data: none (model C starts from the public pretrained CheMeleon foundation-model weights)

## Data
Official training files only (openadmet/cyp-challenge-train-test): direct-inhibition pIC50, TDI labels, Emax and single-concentration screens (the latter two used only as auxiliary training targets/features). No external training data.

## Validation
5-fold scaffold-grouped (Murcko) cross-validation on common folds shared by all models;

Environment
Software
Python in dedicated Conda environments under Windows. Code generated using Google Gemini.


Hardware
Very limited. CPU only, Up to 12Gb available memory (optimistically) out of 32Gb installed. Attempts to use the laptop GPU met with limited success and frequent crashes.


Method - Regression


The training script implements a Chemprop v2 hybrid architecture optimized for regression using multi-modal feature fusion.
